events.title: Another NATO article 4 by...?
events.description:
NATO's Article 4 allows any member to call for consultations with allies if it believes its territorial integrity, political independence, or security to be threatened.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any NATO member invokes Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty between market creation and the specified date 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

Article 4 is considered invoked as soon as a member formally requests consultations with NATO allies under Article 4, regardless of whether the request is later revoked.

For example, Poland's request for consultations on September 10, 2025, or Estonia's request on September 24, 2025 would each qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

If a member state only expresses intent to or is considering invoking Article 4, that alone does not suffice for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from NATO; authoritative statements from the requesting member government may also be used.

events.title: Romania SuperLiga: Team with Most Clean Sheets 2026-27
events.description:
This market will resolve in favor of the team that finishes the 2026-27 Romania SuperLiga season with the most clean sheets. A clean sheet is defined as a match in which the team concedes zero goals.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the team with the fewest total goals conceded during the 2026-27 Romania SuperLiga season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the team with the higher final standing in the 2026-27 Romania SuperLiga. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to "Other".

Only regular season clean sheets will be considered for this market. Clean sheets recorded in playoff, relegation, postseason, preseason, or any other stage of competition will not be considered.

If the 2026-27 Romania SuperLiga season concludes early, is shortened, or is truncated for any reason, the outcome shall be determined using available Romania SuperLiga statistics for completed games.

If the 2026-27 Romania SuperLiga season is cancelled, postponed after June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or it is unclear which team led Romania SuperLiga in clean sheets within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Romania SuperLiga; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
